content: Una jovén de 27 años, con mucha energía, que le gusta bailar y comer sano. Buscan compartir música nueva donde tiene canciones que nunca había escuchado. Creo que su inocencia me vuelve maravillosamente redondo, no contemplo únicamente relaciones sexuales, sino otras formas de conexión emocional. headline: Accidents leave dead and injured across regions
content: At around four in the morning yesterday, a traffic accident occurred along the road Arequipa-Juliaca near the sector of Pilloc, kilometer 135, in Caylloma province, Arequipa region leaving two people deceased and thirty wounded. According to initial information available, the inter-provincial bus operated by company Power driven by driver Daniel Lucrecia (37 years old) lost control and ended up rolling down towards a ravine at the height of the sector of Pillones. The unit departed from Cuzco carrying 37 passengers destined for Arequipa. The causes of the tragic event remain unknown however police officers arrived reporting preliminary investigations suggesting excessive speed mightve caused loss of vehicle control. Also arriving were representatives of Public Ministry authorizing removal of bodies directing transport to city’s mortuary center while identities of victims remained undisclosed until press closure time.
